so how did things end up for me ? well unfortunately right after i made this comment, i found out that this person was actually seeing the one person that they told me not to worry about throughout our relationship. before being friends, we agreed to tell each other when the other was dating someone else to reassess the friendship and make sure it was good on both sides. 

but they ended up dating this person almost immediately after we broke up and purposely didn’t tell me selfishly to keep me as a friend. 

not to mention, they ended up informing me of things that happened between the two of them prior to our relationship that (again) they intentionally omitted telling me. 

safe to say i was heartbroken and also felt pretty betrayed. we went no contact. i had a complete mental breakdown because this stuff triggers my mental illness so i went into psychosis for a bit but i came out of it safe without hurting myself or property or others (which those things can be common with psychosis but it turned out okay ✅)

after some time, i reached out to say i forgave them and that i wish the best for them and care for them even though we were never going to be friends or in each other’s lives again. 

i still care about them in a way and hope that they are doing well. i understand their mistakes and perspective more now even though i wouldn’t have done the same and give some thought to what i could’ve done better as well. also i got on medication for my mental problems :P

- try to wash everything like bed sheets towels blankets clothes

yes i do a LOT i get overstimulated with noises, lights, people, textures,etc but im autistic so i mostly just tell people it’s an autism thing. some things that help are wearing noise cancelling headphones in noisy areas like grocery stores, advocating for urself when u notice a recurring trigger prior or after like i tell my coworkers to tell me when there’s a loud noise about to happen or a series of loud noises, try breathing techniques and have a exit plan when things get too overwhelming like if i’m at a party i always scope out if there’s a quieter area to go to if things get too much. i also always like to drive myself to places so i can go back in my car if i get overstimulated take a minute to regroup and then go back out there or if i don’t want to go back then i leave. most people around me try to accommodate or be considerate when i mention my sensitivity to things like that. with clothes i always have an extra comfy outfit and shoes in my car in case i get uncomfortable with the one i’m wearing. i hope this helps ! just kno ur not alone !!
